control_failures.control_label: positive communication before approaching mobile equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report during start-up after maintenance on HT-9003

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9003 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9003 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 23 March 2011 a hazard report was recorded on HT-9003 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
